# StoneBridge Development Group

> Michigan residential real estate company focused on direct property acquisition, renovation, development, ownership and leasing.

Property inquiries are requests for review, not binding offers or guaranteed purchases.

## Company

- [StoneBridge Development Group | Michigan Real Estate](https://stonebridgedg.com/): StoneBridge Development Group buys, renovates and develops Michigan homes. Explore our properties or request a private, no-obligation cash offer review.
- [About StoneBridge Development Group | Michigan Homes](https://stonebridgedg.com/about): Learn about StoneBridge Development Group, a Michigan company focused on residential property acquisitions, renovation, development and long-term ownership.
- [Contact StoneBridge Development Group | Michigan](https://stonebridgedg.com/contact): Contact StoneBridge Development Group at 248-800-6242 or info@stonebridgedg.com about selling a Michigan property, available homes or a business inquiry.
